releaseNotes:
• Phonetic Default & Settings Switcher: Default Sinhala typing is Singlish Phonetic; easily toggle or set Wijesekara SLS 1134 from App Settings
• Sound & Vibration OFF by default: Completely silent and peaceful out of the box; crystal-clear SoundPool audio and haptics can be enabled in settings
• Native Vector Icons: Replaced all emoji text placeholders across dashboard cards and settings with crisp, professional Material vector drawables
• FUTO-Enhanced Layouts & Sanyaka Shortcuts: Complete mobile Wijesekara, long-press Sanyaka (ඳ, ඟ, ඦ, ඬ, ෴, ඃ), 2-page symbols & 4x5 number pad
• Active Dual Auto-Reporting: Telegram Bot (8822982420) & Google Sheets logging verified 100%
